usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks and Featurebase holds feedback, so “New Task Created in Project” can run “Create Feedback Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Feedback Post” in Featurebase
bestTemplate.why: A task capturing a customer request in Todoist becomes a feedback post your team can prioritize.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist is polling, and every task in that project becomes a feedback post.
